thread:
elaine_sales: Quick sync re: Straitline POC — they need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (group sync), RBAC mapping to Okta groups, domain locking across multiple subdomains, and an audit trail for admin actions. Also asking pricing: hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved GPU pool (monthly commit). They want a security questionnaire answered by EOD tomorrow. Can we align on answers + who owns the SAML attribute mapping?

mike_se: I can handle pricing options. What expected throughput? approx concurrent sessions/tokens?

elaine_sales: They estimate ~20 reqs/sec peak, ~200k tokens/day. Will likely start on hosted but want a committed quote for Dedicated if we need capacity guarantees.

tara_security: For the questionnaire — we'll need their IdP metadata, required SAML attributes (email, name, groups), and confirmation on whether assertions are signed/encrypted. Also confirm KMS/HSM expectations for Private. Do they require user-level PII retention policy? :thinking_face: 

kevin_engineer: On SCIM: group->role mapping is straightforward but we need Okta group IDs. Hosted SCIM supports bursts up to ~60 reqs/min; for bulk org imports we recommend delta syncs or bulk CSV. If they have heavy provisioning, Dedicated can be configured with higher throttle. Example mapping snippet:

```
SCIM mapping:
- okta.groupName => redwood.role
- okta.member -> redwood.user.externalId
```

mike_se: Pricing: Hosted per-token for 200k tokens/day -> rough calc attached in follow-up. Dedicated: baseline 1x A100-equivalent pool + support = fixed committed price (I’ll post numbers). Add-on: higher SCIM throughput and extended audit retention are extra.

elaine_sales: @kevin_engineer can you confirm domain locking flow? They want to restrict tenant to subdomains: *.straitline.com and 365.straitline.com

kevin_engineer: Domain proofing options: DNS TXT or email verification. For wildcard/subdomain enforcement we add tenant-level allowlist. Edge cases: email aliases or forwarded addresses may fail TXT verification; in that case we ask for explicit allowed subdomain list. Audit logs for admin actions are available in Console with configurable retention window.

opsbot: Docs: https://redwood.example/docs/sso-scim-guide  and https://redwood.example/docs/dedicated-pricing

tara_security: I'll draft security questionnaire answers for SAML (assertion signature/enc), SCIM (rate limits + provisioning retention), KMS/HSM, SOC2 details and data retention. Will share by 12:00.

mike_se: I'll prepare 2 pricing options (hosted vs 12-month Dedicated commit) + short TCO blurb. ETA 15:00.

elaine_sales: Owners: mike (pricing), tara (security Q), kevin (tech scoping). I’ll ask Straitline for IdP metadata and a sample Okta group export. Will follow up with a consolidated email. :thumbsup:

kevin_engineer: One more technical note — RBAC mapping: recommend group precedence + fallback 'user' role. For delegated admins map a special Okta group to 'tenant-admin' and enable canary rollouts for elevated permissions. If they need audit-forwarding to SIEM, we support webhook/forwarding on Dedicated/Private.

elaine_sales: Awesome. Closing loop for now — ping if anyone hits blockers when drafting the Q or pricing.
